Name: Barabbas
Summary: Barabbas was a notorious prisoner, held for insurrection and murder, whom Pilate released at the Passover feast while the crowd demanded Jesus be crucified in his place.
KeyStory: The crowd chose Barabbas and sent Jesus to the cross, and the guilty man walked free on the innocent man's sentence.
LifeLesson: Barabbas is every one of us: set free because another took his place. His freedom cost Jesus His life.
